alternative_explanations: The admissible possible-output bound, rather than learned ordering, may account for all savings versus exhaustive MDL; the support-only and frozen source-identical roles isolate this.
Uniform held-out program sampling may make meta priorities statistically uninformative, so support-local ordering can match or beat meta learning.
confounds: The visible finite 256-program benchmark measures amortized exact search in a small class and cannot establish open-ended program synthesis or an LLM successor.
K changes both meta-training corpus size and padded tape capacity; full acquisition and fit accounting is required before interpreting a near-zero query slope.
falsification_criteria: Discard unless meta-role accuracy, length extrapolation accuracy and program induction accuracy are exactly 1.0 in every cell.
Discard unless meta-role mean cold search nodes and search operations are strictly below support-only, frozen and complete enumerative MDL overall and at D6.
Discard unless meta-role workload_ops_r1, workload_ops_r4 and workload_ops_r16 are below complete enumerative MDL and neither source-identical ablation Pareto-dominates it at exact capability.

Invalidate if roles differ beyond priority source, return a different optimum than exhaustive MDL, access a hidden program or trace, omit fit/search/state/bytes work, exceed 16777216 bytes, tune after score or fail baseline/preflight/integrity gates.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify the implementation and exact rule if any exactness, source-identity, audit, state or integrity gate fails; do not tune ordering after seeing the seed.
outcome_policy.null: Falsify this exact priority learner if all roles are exact but meta ordering fails to improve fully charged work over source-identical or exhaustive controls; preserve branch-and-bound as a classical solver.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0047 testing only if exact capability is preserved and meta ordering strictly improves node, search and all declared workload costs without Pareto dominance; then preregister unchanged multi-seed adversarial replication.

predicted_outcome: All three causal roles must recover the identical exact MDL program in every K=8/16/32 and D=1/4/6 cell. The meta-learned order is predicted to visit fewer branch nodes and use fewer cold search operations than support-only, frozen and exhaustive MDL, including at D6, while query work has near-zero K slope. The expected outcome is a stringent null because the program distribution is uniform and charged meta-fit may erase search savings.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. A positive only authorizes an unchanged three-seed adversarial screen with new support corruption positions and a larger program class after prior-art review; promotion still requires replicated non-dominance.
research_question: Can meta-experience lower the fully charged node and operation cost of exact noisy whole-I/O program induction by changing only branch and constraint visitation order while preserving the identical complete MDL optimum on every unseen program?
title: Amortized exact constraint-search ordering scout

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any implementable role receives the hidden program, execution trace or task identity.
Invalidate unless all three causal roles share the exact complete branch-and-bound solver, objective, tie handling, constants, support parsing, execution and output code.
Invalidate if the learned role differs from its ablations beyond the preregistered source of branch and constraint priorities.
Invalidate if a role stops before proving the same minimum-error MDL optimum returned by complete enumeration.
Invalidate if acquisition, meta-fit, every visited node, program execution, query, update, state or bytes touched is omitted from full cost.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, external model or API use, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.
